comment: Boxes are the ink boxes on the first train/good crop, in px from the film's top-left corner. 'blocks' run left to right and form the chain left edge -> block -> gap -> ... -> right edge; 'free_blocks' are only measured to the left and top edges. Tolerances in mm on the label plane (camera/calibration.json). No date block: the film is often cut through the date on good labels. Boxes moved from archive/data_20261117 (sku02) by dx 10, dy 3 px on 2026-11-20. 2026-11-20: tolerance 3.0 mm (good labels move up to 2.7 mm to the film edges: the film is cut a little differently each time), gaps between letters 1.5 mm (good up to 1.03 mm).
